description.p: ArchiveKeep helps you preserve your personal files by maintaining identical copies across multiple storage locations — without risking corruption or data loss during synchronization.
Once a file is archived, it stays unchanged. ArchiveKeep never overwrites existing copies with modifications or corrupted data, ensuring your archives remain intact over time.

ul.li: Plain files — no proprietary format, readable with any application.
Incremental synchronization — replicates new files or moves when storages become available, working fully offline.
SHA-256 file fingerprinting — fast verification that catches silent bit-rot before it spreads.
Multi-platform — available on Linux desktop and Android.
No vendor lock-in — you control where your files live.
Google Drive — convenient, familiar, widely available.
S3-compatible APIs — choose any vendor that supports the S3 protocol.

p.em: ArchiveKeep is in active development and improving with each release. Feedback and bug reports are welcome.
